name: item
title: Item
description: shadcn's list-row parts — `Item`, `ItemMedia`, `ItemContent`, `ItemTitle`, `ItemDescription`, `ItemActions`, `ItemHeader`, `ItemFooter`, `ItemGroup`, `ItemSeparator` — on both halves, with shadcn's names and props. `size="default"` is shadcn's row; `size="sm"` is `ListItem`'s, which is built from these parts. For a row `ListItem` does not fit: a header or footer line, a badge beside the title.
